name: CryptoAudit
official_name_basis: ChatGPTのアプリ詳細画面に表示された名称
original_description: CryptoAudit: Crypto AI helps people analyze cryptocurrency markets inside ChatGPT. Users can view live charts, check market summaries, compare coins, review technical indicators like RSI and MACD, see support and resistance levels, track market sentiment, spot unusual whale activity, and explore AI-based price outlooks. It is built for quick research and clearer decision-making with simple, practical crypto insights.
description_scope: ChatGPTのアプリ詳細に表示された提供元の英語説明
summary_ja: 暗号資産のチャートや指標、市場の動き、AIによる価格見通しを調べるツール。
limitations_ja: 価格見通しを含む分析結果の正確性やライブデータの鮮度は未検証。
